description: Herkunft der KI-generierten Grafiken (Grafik-Spezifikation v2, Kap. 7.3)

texture/grassland_1.prompt: seamless tileable top-down painted texture in exactly the hand-painted stylized look of the reference images, viewed straight from above, even lighting, no objects, no hexagon lines, no borders, no text, edges must tile seamlessly, lush green meadow grass with small lighter and darker patches and a few tiny flowers, matching the grass colour and brushwork of the reference

prop/tree_conifer_1.prompt: isometric strategy game asset in exactly the hand-painted stylized look of the reference images, soft painterly texture, light from upper left, soft short shadow to lower right, view from above at about 30 degrees, single isolated object centered on a plain flat pure white background, no ground plane, no text, no border, one single dark green conifer pine tree with a short brown trunk, like the pine trees in the reference

prop/rock_1.prompt: isometric strategy game asset in exactly the hand-painted stylized look of the reference images, soft painterly texture, light from upper left, soft short shadow to lower right, view from above at about 30 degrees, single isolated object centered on a plain flat pure white background, no ground plane, no text, no border, one single grey granite boulder with soft moss patches on top, same rock colour and shading as the cliffs in the reference

portrait/spearman.prompt: painted character portrait for a strategy game unit panel in exactly the hand-painted stylized look of the reference images, three-quarter body, painted landscape background, no frame, no text, bearded medieval spearman with steel kettle helmet, blue tunic, round blue shield with a white plant emblem, holding a tall spear, standing in a green valley with mountains, same character as the reference portrait

texture/coast_1.prompt: seamless tileable top-down painted texture in exactly the hand-painted stylized look of the reference images, viewed straight from above, even lighting, no objects, no hexagon lines, no borders, no text, edges must tile seamlessly, shallow turquoise coastal water with soft light caustic ripples and a few subtle wave highlights, matching the light blue water near the shore in the reference

texture/ocean_1.prompt: seamless tileable top-down painted texture in exactly the hand-painted stylized look of the reference images, viewed straight from above, even lighting, no objects, no hexagon lines, no borders, no text, edges must tile seamlessly, deep saturated blue sea water with soft painted wave streaks and small white highlights, matching the open sea in the reference

wall/cliff_temperate.prompt: seamless tileable painted texture of a vertical surface seen straight from the front in exactly the hand-painted stylized look of the reference images, light from upper left, no sky, no ground, no objects, no borders, no text, edges must tile seamlessly in both directions, grey granite cliff face made of large vertical rock columns and blocky facets with small moss tufts in the cracks, same rock colour and shading as the cliffs in the reference

wall/slope.prompt: seamless tileable painted texture of a vertical surface seen straight from the front in exactly the hand-painted stylized look of the reference images, light from upper left, no sky, no ground, no objects, no borders, no text, edges must tile seamlessly in both directions, hillside bank of brown earth with small pebbles and a few green grass tufts, painted terrain texture
